_comment: ``random_doc`` builds documents around the edges of every range (in, at and just past each limit, wrong types, unknown names, missing keys) on frames and lengths that put the render-time charge on both sides of the export's allowance. samples/timeline_parity2_fuzz.json holds the documents with modules/timeline.py's verdict; this test makes them again from the seed (the file must be current) and command-center/tests/editor-parity2.test.ts judges every one with lib/editor.ts: the two must agree. Regenerate with ``python3 -m tests.test_editor_parity2_fuzz --write``.
